purpose: Repair native active-skill suit validation and wording in the shared WPF confirmation draft.
changes: CanConfirmActiveSkill retains current native card/target counts and selectable IDs, then checks both SelectedCardsSameSuit and SelectedCardsDistinctSuits against physical Suit values in the current player-safe snapshot.

Physical costs can be read from Hand, Equipment, Judgment, Wooden Ox grain, Buqu wounds, Authority and Chunlao public collections without trusted engine-state reads. The existing current-selectable-ID gate remains authoritative.
Current skill hints and the context guide now explain same-suit or pairwise-distinct-suit requirements.
The retained equipment/skill-control check now exercises two equipped Diamond entities through actual OL Longhun rail, equipment-choice buttons, confirmation button and Enter.

The retained composed-skill check now exercises a native four-distinct-suit OL Yeyan action, exact-count invalid drafts, actual disabled confirmation, Enter preservation, valid one-time payment and cold restore.
Only the existing equipment-layout filter is added to routine scope; all retained registrations and assertions remain.

The retained sorted-hand keyboard fixture now establishes a bounded idle-input prerequisite before synthetic Space Down and Up, logs WPF and Win32 device/pressed/focus/handled states, and releases only its own button capture in finally. Existing actual button, one-time selection and complete keyboard reveal assertions remain.

assertions: Fixed seed 31, native StartGame / SelectGeneral / bounded AdvanceOneStep and the current manual-save boundary establish the human Play fixtures. Fixtures grant the actual native skill to a fixture general; this is not full official-general stat acceptance.
Longhun Crossbow/45 and BaguaFormation/32 are separately equipped through accepted physical PlayCard commands with exact Hand -> Processing -> Equipment paths before testing the product.
Both actual Longhun routes select exactly the two equipped IDs and a published target, with no selected Hand cards or premature revision, command, movement, event or four-view changes.

Button and Enter each submit one exact UseProgramSkillCommand for ol:longhun / two-diamond, original revision and prompt, and the two equipment IDs. The resulting native FireSlash has ol:longhun / 2-diamond provenance.
Each Longhun equipment cost moves once through Equipment -> Processing (use) -> Discard (use-finished). Cold checkpoint restore matches all four player-safe views.

Native Yeyan / two publishes min/max four and SelectedCardsDistinctSuits. IDs 27,32,45,73 have Club,Diamond,Spade,Spade, remain individually published selectable, and are invalid only as a combined suit set.

An independent restored native game rejects that invalid exact command as InvalidCard with unchanged revision, command/movement/event counts and all four player-safe views. Invalid UI Enter does not submit or pay and preserves the exact draft for correction.

A valid four-suit set enables the actual same confirmation button; its one exact native submission pays each Hand cost once, matches an independently restored accepted native reference including HP changes, and survives cold checkpoint restore.
Context-guide opening and cancellation preserve the game boundary; the hint and guide both explain the distinct-suit restriction.

findings: Both actual equipped-cost buttons show selection and no Hand cost is highlighted.
The same-suit requirement fits in the visible action area, the published target is selected, and the actual confirmation button is enabled.
visualInspection.delivery: Temporary render retained in registered verification outputs; the durable report preserves the findings.

limits: In-process WPF binding, real controls and shortcut entry points are verified; no foreground native mouse/key automation or human play acceptance is claimed.

Flagged native activations currently use Hand or Hand plus Equipment. Public collections are statically included by the helper, with retained public-pile UI checks still green; no flagged public-pile suit fixture was introduced.
Core rule implementation, persisted formats, rules/schema/package versions and trusted private-state boundaries are unchanged by this batch. This report does not claim a new Core rule.
Only focused and measured routine scopes ran. Manual Full, release/publish/packaging, commit and push were not invoked.

The sorted-hand Space fixture still depends on real input devices. It now explicitly fails after two seconds if its prerequisites do not hold; a physical input race after the prerequisite remains possible. The first failed run had no WPF/KeyState/Async-state diagnostics, so the exact device cause of that original failure is inferred, not directly observed.
